courses.title: How to Read & Write Proofs
courses.blurb: Logic, sets, induction, proof patterns. The on-ramp to analysis and topology.

courses.title: Calculus
courses.blurb: Single + multivariable, through vector calculus.

courses.title: Linear Algebra
courses.blurb: Through spectral theorem, SVD, and inner-product spaces.

courses.title: Differential Equations
courses.blurb: ODEs, linear systems, phase portraits, intro PDEs.

courses.title: Probability & Statistics
courses.blurb: Distributions, expectation, LLN/CLT, Bayes, basic inference.

courses.title: Newtonian Mechanics
courses.blurb: Kinematics through rotation, oscillations, central forces.

courses.title: Electromagnetism
courses.blurb: Maxwell's equations and what they mean.

courses.title: Game Theory
courses.blurb: Normal/extensive form, Nash, mixed strategies, repeated games.

courses.title: Mathematical Microeconomics
courses.blurb: Consumer/producer theory, Lagrangians, comparative statics.

courses.title: Real Analysis
courses.blurb: Sequences, limits, continuity, integration, uniform convergence — with proofs.

courses.title: Complex Analysis
courses.blurb: Holomorphy, Cauchy's theorem, residues, conformal maps.

courses.title: Topology
courses.blurb: Point-set core plus a taste of the fundamental group.

courses.title: Probability Theory
courses.blurb: Measure-theoretic-lite: sigma-algebras, convergence, conditional expectation, martingales.

courses.title: Analytical Mechanics
courses.blurb: Calculus of variations, Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, Noether. The gateway to QM.

courses.title: Grad Game Theory
courses.blurb: Optimization & fixed points, existence proofs, Bayesian games, mechanism design, folk theorems.

courses.title: Grad Microeconomics
courses.blurb: Optimization module, choice axioms, general equilibrium, welfare theorems, information economics.

courses.title: Quantum Mechanics
courses.blurb: State vectors, operators, Schrödinger equation, spin, entanglement, perturbation theory.

courses.title: Statistical Mechanics
courses.blurb: Ensembles, entropy, partition functions, phase transitions.

courses.title: Relativity (SR + GR)
courses.blurb: SR from postulates, a differential-geometry interlude, then Einstein's equations and cosmology.

courses.title: Astrophysics
courses.blurb: Stellar structure, compact objects, galaxies, cosmology. The capstone.
